title: An erase can drop another device's new reminders token adopted during its prepare's await, leaving that row live
evidence: Done 2026-11-14: Option B plus the F1 fold-in (owner-approved). cancelRemindersForErase (widget-src/standalone/reminders.ts) now holds one union, EraseCancel = unprepared | watching{at, cancels[]} | done, changed only by the pure eraseCancelTransition (table test in reminders.test.ts); it replaces the loose cancel value. The prepare listens on hr:remote-changed while getEraseIdentity() is still the erase's, and keeps each distinct active token seen from its first read until the swap, in memory only. The commit cancels each, keepalive: the first with its Drive proof, the others bare (a tombstone stops the emails); a failed cancel is reported by its HTTP status alone. The listener is removed at the commit, when the prepare throws, and at the first hr:remote-changed after the identity moves or stillShown(at) is true again (a refused erase). F1: cancelReminders checks stillShown(erase) after the proof await and refuses before the POST (ERASE_IN_PROGRESS or RECORD_CHANGED_SINCE_ASKED, as the post-write refusal says), so no row is cancelled under a switch that stays on. Residual W3 (a token written after the erase read the stored record and never merged in before the swap, dropped by merge.ts ~:787-830) is lead H126. Tests: widget-src/standalone/reminders-erase-cancel.test.ts (W1, W2, refused erase, listener exits, no token logged, extra cancel status only), reminders-cancel-superseded.test.ts, reminders.test.ts (transition table, AC17 rows 6c/6d, listener self-removal). US-11 AC4, AC4b, AC4c; US-17 AC17. Was: Found during S59. cancelRemindersForErase (widget-src/standalone/reminders.ts:375-391) reads the opt-in at :378 and then awaits cancelProofFor at :379. The erase adopts any active opt-in from the stored and device copies before it (packages/health-core/src/record-session-erase.ts:97-108), then runs beforeErase (:109), then builds the erased file (:113), which holds no opt-in. If a remote adopt lands during the :379 await and brings another device's new reminders token, the prepare still holds the old token, the commit cancels only that one, and the erase drops the new token from the file. That device's server row stays live and its reminders keep going until its email unsubscribe link is used. The same window existed before PR 1674 (the teardown ran in the same place). First confirm an adopt can land while erasing (record-session.ts:209 refuses some work while saveMode is erasing). Fix options: re-read the opt-in after the await and cancel every active token seen; or take the token from the merged file the erase builds from. US-11 AC2, AC4c.
